i1.title: Lattafa Pride Gift Set Collection No.5 Eau de Parfum 5 x 20ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Five Lattafa Pride scents, from creamy coconut florals to aromatic lavender.

The Lattafa Pride Gift Set Collection No.5 brings together five Lattafa Pride fragrances in 20ml Eau de Parfum bottles: La Collection d'Antiquités 1910, Shaheen Silver, African Drummer, Ishq Al Shuyukh Silver and Vintage Radio. It is an easy way to explore the range, wear a different scent each day or share as a gift.

What's in the set

  • La Collection d'Antiquités 1910 – a sweet fruity-floral gourmand of apple, rose, osmanthus, tonka and vanilla
  • Shaheen Silver – fresh and fruity: blackcurrant and bergamot over rose, patchouli, amber and oakmoss
  • African Drummer – creamy coconut and bergamot with jasmine, orange blossom, ylang-ylang and vanilla
  • Ishq Al Shuyukh Silver – fresh citrus-woody with lemon, bergamot, pineapple, cedar and vanilla
  • Vintage Radio – aromatic lavender and sage with spicy plum and black pepper over sandalwood

Key details

  • Brand: Lattafa Pride
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Contents: 5 x 20ml
  • Scent profile: Fruity · Floral · Woody
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • Five Lattafa Pride fragrances in one box
  • Handy 20ml size for travel or your bag
  • A great way to find your favourite
  • Ready to give as a gift

FAQ

Which fragrances are in the set?

La Collection d'Antiquités 1910, Shaheen Silver, African Drummer, Ishq Al Shuyukh Silver and Vintage Radio, each 20ml Eau de Parfum.

Is it unisex?

Yes, the set is made for everyone.

i2.title: Maison Alhambra Karat Eau de Parfum 100ml
i2.descriptionHtml:
Juicy peach and passion fruit over lily of the valley, vanilla and musk.

Maison Alhambra Karat Eau de Parfum 100ml is a bright, fruity fragrance. Peach, passion fruit and pear open juicily, a heart of lily of the valley follows, and it settles on a soft base of musk, vanilla and heliotrope.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Peach, Passion Fruit, Pear
  • Heart: Lily of the Valley
  • Base: Musk, Vanilla, Heliotrope

Key details

  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Fruity · Floral · Musky
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A juicy opening of peach, passion fruit and pear
  • A fresh floral heart of lily of the valley
  • A soft, powdery base of musk, vanilla and heliotrope
  • Easy everyday Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Karat smell like?

Peach, passion fruit and pear first, then lily of the valley, finishing with musk, vanilla and heliotrope.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.
